def chosen_token_confidence(model: DecoderStack, prompts: Tensor, field: Tensor) -> Tensor:
    logits = model(torch.cat([prompts, field], dim=1))[:, prompts.shape[1] :]
    probs = logits.softmax(dim=-1)
    return probs.gather(-1, field.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)


def adaptive_decode(
    config: ExperimentConfig, joint_thinker: DecoderStack, talker: DecoderStack, prompts: Tensor
) -> tuple[Tensor, float]:
    field_len = config.think_len + config.answer_len
    field = diffusion_sample(
        joint_thinker, prompts, field_len, config.diffusion_steps, 0.0, config.seed
    )
    confidence = chosen_token_confidence(joint_thinker, prompts, field)
    answer_confidence = confidence[:, config.think_len :].min(dim=-1).values
    fast = answer_confidence >= config.gate_confidence
    answers = field[:, config.think_len :].clone()
    slow_rows = (~fast).nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
    if slow_rows.numel() > 0:
        slow_think = field[slow_rows][:, : config.think_len]
        slow_answers, _ = talker_generate(
            talker, prompts[slow_rows], slow_think, config.answer_len
        )
        answers[slow_rows] = slow_answers
    return answers, float(fast.float().mean().item())


def run_adaptive_experiment(config: ExperimentConfig) -> dict[str, float]:
    torch.manual_seed(config.seed)
    train_p, train_t, train_a, test_p, _, test_a = build_dataset(config)
    field_len = config.think_len + config.answer_len
    joint_thinker = DecoderStack(
        config, config.thinker_layers, config.prompt_len + field_len, False
    )
    talker_len = config.prompt_len + config.think_len + config.answer_len + 2
    talker = DecoderStack(config, config.talker_layers, talker_len, True)
    baseline_len = config.prompt_len + config.answer_len + 1
    baseline = DecoderStack(config, config.baseline_layers, baseline_len, True)
    train_field = torch.cat([train_t, train_a], dim=1)
    train_model(config, joint_thinker, (train_p, train_field), "diffusion")
    talker_config = ExperimentConfig(
        **{**config.__dict__, "steps": talker_steps_for(config, config.steps)}
    )
    train_model(talker_config, talker, (train_p, train_t, train_a), "talker")
    train_model(config, baseline, (train_p, train_a), "baseline")
    test_p = test_p.to(config.device)
    test_a = test_a.to(config.device)
    with torch.no_grad():
        adaptive_answer, fast_fraction = adaptive_decode(config, joint_thinker, talker, test_p)
        field = diffusion_sample(
            joint_thinker, test_p, field_len, config.diffusion_steps, 0.0, config.seed
        )
        diffusion_answer = field[:, config.think_len :]
        escalated_answer, _ = talker_generate(
            talker, test_p, field[:, : config.think_len], config.answer_len
        )
        baseline_answer = baseline_generate(baseline, test_p, config.answer_len)
    return {
        "adaptive_accuracy": exact_match(adaptive_answer, test_a),
        "fast_path_fraction": fast_fraction,
        "diffusion_only_accuracy": exact_match(diffusion_answer, test_a),
        "escalate_all_accuracy": exact_match(escalated_answer, test_a),
        "baseline_accuracy": exact_match(baseline_answer, test_a),
    }

def test_chosen_token_confidence_shape_and_range() -> None:
    config = tiny_config()
    torch.manual_seed(config.seed)
    train_p, train_t, _, _, _, _ = build_dataset(config)
    model = DecoderStack(config, 1, PROMPT_LEN + THINK_LEN, False)
    with torch.no_grad():
        confidence = chosen_token_confidence(model, train_p[:8], train_t[:8])
    assert confidence.shape == (8, THINK_LEN)
    assert ((confidence > 0.0) & (confidence <= 1.0)).all()


def test_adaptive_decode_gate_extremes() -> None:
    config = tiny_config()
    torch.manual_seed(config.seed)
    train_p, train_t, train_a, _, _, _ = build_dataset(config)
    field_len = THINK_LEN + ANSWER_LEN
    joint = DecoderStack(config, 1, PROMPT_LEN + field_len, False)
    talker = DecoderStack(config, 1, PROMPT_LEN + field_len + 2, True)
    config.gate_confidence = 1.1
    with torch.no_grad():
        slow_answers, slow_fraction = adaptive_decode(config, joint, talker, train_p[:8])
    assert slow_fraction == 0.0
    config.gate_confidence = 0.0
    with torch.no_grad():
        fast_answers, fast_fraction = adaptive_decode(config, joint, talker, train_p[:8])
    assert fast_fraction == 1.0
    assert slow_answers.shape == fast_answers.shape == (8, ANSWER_LEN)


def test_adaptive_decode_fast_path_matches_diffusion_answer_slice() -> None:
    config = tiny_config()
    torch.manual_seed(config.seed)
    train_p, _, _, _, _, _ = build_dataset(config)
    field_len = THINK_LEN + ANSWER_LEN
    joint = DecoderStack(config, 1, PROMPT_LEN + field_len, False)
    talker = DecoderStack(config, 1, PROMPT_LEN + field_len + 2, True)
    config.gate_confidence = 0.0
    with torch.no_grad():
        answers, _ = adaptive_decode(config, joint, talker, train_p[:8])
        field = diffusion_sample(joint, train_p[:8], field_len, config.diffusion_steps, 0.0, config.seed)
    assert torch.equal(answers, field[:, THINK_LEN:])


def test_run_adaptive_experiment_reports_metrics() -> None:
    config = tiny_config()
    config.steps = 8
    results = run_adaptive_experiment(config)
    expected = {
        "adaptive_accuracy",
        "fast_path_fraction",
        "diffusion_only_accuracy",
        "escalate_all_accuracy",
        "baseline_accuracy",
    }
    assert set(results) == expected
    assert 0.0 <= results["fast_path_fraction"] <= 1.0
